questions.question: Which of the following articles of the Constitution of India mentions that every Minister and the Attorney-General of India shall have the right to speak in and participate in the proceedings of either House of Parliament?
Which of the following articles mentions about the Appropriation Bills in the state legislature?
Which of the following Articles entails “Equality of opportunity in matters of public employment”?
Which of the following Articles is automatically suspended when an emergency is declared on the grounds of external aggression?
Under Article 165, the Governor appoints a person who is qualified to be appointed a Judge of a High Court to be the _________ for the State.
Which of the following Articles of the Constitution of India emphasises the participation of workers in the management of industries?
According to Article ____, no religious instruction shall be provided in any educational institution wholly maintained out of State funds.
Which Article of the Constitution of India deals with the composition of the Legislative Council?
According to Article 280 of the Indian Constitution, the Finance Commission needs to be appointed for every ________________.

Which Article of the Constitution of India directs the State to provide public assistance to its citizens in case of unemployment, old age, sickness and disablement, within the limits of its economic capacity and development?
At the time of its adoption, the Constitution contained 395 Articles and ________ Schedules.
The Right to Freedom of Religion is covered under which Articles of the Constitution of India?
As per Article 157 of the Constitution of India, a person needs to complete the age of ____________ years to be appointed as Governor.
The Directive Principles of State Policy are considered fundamental in the governance of the country, but they are not enforceable by any court. This concept is mentioned in which Article?
Which Article of the Constitution of India describes a key feature of ‘Universal Adult Franchise’ that grants the right to vote to citizens, above the age of 18 years in India?
In 1976, in which Part of the Indian Constitution under Article 51A were Fundamental Duties added?
According to Article 74(1), who is at the head of the Council of Ministers?
Which of the following Articles on Fundamental Duties was added to the Indian Constitution by the 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act?
Which Article of the Constitution of India specifically addresses the qualifications for the office of the President?
As per Article 51A of the Constitution of India, Fundamental Duty (h) is to develop the ________________, humanism and the spirit of inquiry and reform.
According to Article _____, there shall be equality of opportunities for all citizens in matters relating to employment or appointment to any office under the State.
Article __________ A supplements the 11th fundamental duty of the Indian Constitution?
Which Articles of the Constitution of India provide for a parliamentary form of government at the Centre?
'Promotion of educational and economic interests of Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and other weaker sections' comes under which Article of Indian constitution?
Which of the following Rights is mentioned in Article 21 of the Indian Constitution?
questions.option_1: Right against Exploitation: Prohibition of trafficking in human beings and forced labour
questions.option_2: Right to Freedom of Religion: Freedom to manage religious affairs
questions.option_3: Right to Equality: Equality before law
questions.option_4: Right to Freedom: Protection of life and personal liberty
